<div class="card-body">
'''Myo''' is a [[Dark]] [[Character]] ([[Alien]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ミョー</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">ライリン・カーンかバウンティ・ハンターと同じ場所にいるなら戦闘力＋１。戦闘によってロスト、あるいは消耗しても、ミョーは“再生”する（自分のユーズドデッキの一番上に置かれる）。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-189o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">ビス出身の単眼種アビシン。再生能力を持ち、野蛮、狂暴、恐れ知らずで、傭兵志願の砂漠の民。ライリン・カーンの仲間。自分を“１つ目”と呼ぶやつを許さない。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Myo.

'''Card text:''' Power +1 if present with Lirin Car'n or a bounty hunter. If lost or forfeited in battle, Myo “regenerates” (place on top of your Used Pile).

'''Lore:''' A one-eyed Abyssin from Byss. Regenerating, savage, violent, fearless desert people who volunteer as mercenaries. Companion of Lirin Car'n. Will not forgive anyone who calls him “one-eye.”
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Myo]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 98. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
